title: Versioned vocabulary mapping setting and system descriptors to Lara symbols
x-consumer-invariants: settings are sorted by descriptor.descriptor_id and systems by descriptor.system_id; every embedded descriptor's identity recomputes

each (measurand, setting) symbol pair names exactly one setting descriptor; descriptors sharing a measurand symbol share the same metric (name, definition_digest, polarity, unit); descriptors sharing a setting symbol agree on everything except the metric; each system symbol names exactly one system descriptor and no symbol is both a system and a setting or measurand symbol
measurand polarity must equal the 'measurand <symbol> : Num where <polarity>' declaration of the pinned policy file; Lara checks polarity, this registry only names it

a vocabulary extension is a new registry: revision increases by one, previous names the earlier registry_id, and every earlier symbol keeps its exact descriptor; rebinding or dropping a symbol requires a new vocabulary name

the argument producer uses registered symbols rather than local synonyms; authorized reviewers check that source bindings justify the descriptors; matching formal symbols alone never establishes comparable experiments

members are checked under one exact registry_id; a member bound to another registry is rechecked under the new one or excluded with reason vocabulary_mismatch; old verdicts stay with their original registry
